repositories.pin_provenance: Reuse unchanged M19 source manifest/repository pin.

method: Public web search/open, immutable HTTPS byte retrieval, and scoped source/PDF inspection on PyPy 7.3.23 implementing Python 3.11.15. Bundled pure-Python pypdf 6.10.0 used for PDF extraction; no Factor dependency added.
cleanup: Task-owned public downloads and extracted text are digest-verified and removed after review. No upstream code execution or installation.
limitations: Native and historical timings are not PyPy performance evidence.
Implementation pin dates identify reviewed revisions; no current fastest-engine ranking.
ePrint byte fetch returned HTTP 403; publisher PDF successfully fetched instead.
